svg.title: Synthetic local dynamical-complexity trace
svg.desc: What this figure shows: This is a synthetic benchmark for state-transition analysis; it is not presented as a validated consciousness measure. The plotted object is generated from C_t illustrated by a local multiscale variation statistic. How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Synthetic test signal. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
